title: Checklist
description: An ordered list of steps: a checklist, a flow or a non-normal procedure.

basis.description:
Kinds of material this list was checked against, from the tags the pack declares.
Never a document name or a link.

id.description: The list's id, unique in the pack; other files and patches name the list by it.

method.description: How the list is used. Optional.

title.description: The list's title, as the app shows it.

AutoStart.description: Steps whose ticks start a timer by itself; `check` makes sure each step named exists.

from.description: The steps whose ticks start the timer; `check` makes sure each is a step in the pack.

pick.description: Which of those ticks starts it: the `earliest` or the `latest`.

AutoStartPick.description: Which of several ticked steps starts a timer.

Confirmation.description:
An internal maintenance record (decision 0013): the kind of source and the day it was
recorded, never who or which document. The app never shows it.

kind.description: The kind of source it was confirmed against.

ConfirmationKind.description:
What a step or light note was confirmed against (decision 0013, which defines each kind).
The list grows by adding a kind there and here.

oneOf.description: Matches the aircraft developer's documentation for the simulated aircraft.
Matches an official public document from an aviation authority.

ExpectWhen.description:
A step's value once a decision has answered an option with this value (decision 0027),
e.g. "MAIN PUMPS ON · CENTER PUMPS OFF". Until it is answered, the step's own `expect`
shows.

equals.description: The answer this value is for.

expect.description: The step's value once the option has that answer.

FieldId.description:
A flight field's id, e.g. `zfw`: one of the fields the pack defines in `flight.yaml`
(decision 0029), or one of the app's own, [`FieldId::MANUAL`] and [`FieldId::ROUTE_LEG`].
Saved flights key their values by it, as text.

HintPart.description: One piece of a hint shown beside a step, e.g. `GND` and the ground frequency.

field.description: The flight field whose value follows the prefix.

prefix.description: Literal text before the value, including any space, e.g. `SQUAWK `.

LightState.description: The state a step expects a light in.

ListKind.description: What kind of list this is.

oneOf.description: Read and confirm after the work is done.
A sequence of actions done from memory or by following along.

ListMethod.description: How a list is used (decision 0029). Its display name comes from the pack's labels.

oneOf.description: Each step done as it is read.
One crew member reads each item, the other answers (a step's `respond`).

OptionTest.description: One test against a pilot-chosen option. The options are declared by the pack.

anyOf.description: Passes when the option has this value.
Passes when the option has one of these values.

one_of.description: The values, any one of which passes.

Quick.description: When a step still shows in quick mode.

oneOf.description:
In Essentials only when the start options make a turnaround (`turnaround` in
`phases.yaml`).

ShowIf.description:
When something is shown. Deliberately small: tests combine one level deep, with no
negation, comparisons, step state or expressions.

all_of.description: The tests, all of which must pass.

any_of.description: The tests, one of which must pass.

branch.description:
The step opens a case of its own ("IF RUNAWAY CONTINUES"): which case applies decides
what follows, so Practice never asks across it. Never on a list's first step.

check.description:
How to tell the step worked, shown under Check. Takes the place of the shared
explanation's.

check_detail.description: More on Check, shown after it. Used only with the step's own `check`.

confirmed_by.description: Internal record of what this step was confirmed against (decision 0013).

controls.description: Ids from the pack's controls file.

decide.description:
A decision step: it asks the pilot this option (by id), and the answer sets it for the
flight. Targets elsewhere may depend on the answer (decision 0022).

expect.description:
The expected response or position, e.g. "NAV". Always text, never a boolean.
`___` marks a blank the pilot fills in.

expect_when.description: The step's value for each answer of a decision its targets depend on (decision 0027).

fill.description: One field per `___` in `expect`, in order.

hint.description: Flight values shown beside the expected response.

how.description: Id of a shared "how to do it" note.

id.description:
The step's id, `<prefix>.<phase>.<short-name>`, unique in the pack. It never changes
once published; a renamed id gets a `step` alias in `aliases.yaml`.

if_not.description:
What to do when Check fails, shown under If not. Takes the place of the shared
explanation's.

if_not_detail.description: More on If not, shown after it. Used only with the step's own `if_not`.

location.description: Overrides the location text of the step's first control.

look_for.description: What to look for, shown as "Look for" when the step is open.

non_recall.description: In a memory list: read this step rather than recalling it.

not_simulated.description: The simulator does not model this step, so it is left out of progress.

note.description: Optional note shown under the step.

note_caution.description:
The note is a caution: it stays visible on the step (under If not) instead of in How
to do it. Changes only where the note shows, never its wording.

number.description: Printed number; absent for steps that are not numbered.

opens.description:
The id of the CDU walkthrough for this step; `check` makes sure it exists. The step,
when it's current, opens it.

panel_lights.description: Panel lights this step refers to: control id, then light labels.

quick.description:
Puts the step in Essentials: `always`, or `turnaround`. Without it, the step shows only
when the pilot sees every step.

respond.description:
In a challenge-and-response list, who answers the challenge: a role id from the
pack's labels.

role.description: Who does the step: a role id from the pack's labels (decision 0029). Optional.

section.description: Starts a new titled section at this step.

show_if.description: Shows the step only when the pilot's option choices pass this test.

sim_simplified.description: The simulator simplifies the real aircraft here.

simulator_model.description: The step's note describes how the simulator behaves, not the real aircraft.

targets.description:
The panel items the step involves and the state it asks of each, which the control
drawings show exactly (decision 0018). `involo-pack check` holds them to the step's wording.

terms.description: Glossary terms the step uses, shown under Why (each must be in the glossary).

timer.description:
A wait attached to the step: a timer the step's tick, or its trigger steps' ticks,
start.

walkaround.description:
The step's stop on the exterior inspection's top view: the step pane and the phone's
step card draw every stop of the list there, numbered by step `number`.

why.description: Why the step matters, shown under Why. Takes the place of the shared explanation's.

StepId.description:
A stable step id: `<pack-id>.<phase>.<short-name>`, e.g. `demo-aircraft.preflight.irs-mode`.
An id never changes once published, even if the step is reworded or moved to another phase.

StepTarget.description: One panel item a step involves, and what the step asks of it (decision 0018).

at.description:
The item, as `panel/section/LABEL/n`: the n-th item (from 1) with that label in the
section, as light notes name them.

light.description:
The state the step expects a light in. Leave it out for a light that may cycle (window
heat ON lights), so a drawing never claims a state the light may not be in.

open.description:
The step's wording names one of the item's positions, but leaves it open: a condition
("ON IF MORE THAN 1,000 LB"), an option, one engine of two, or the word belongs to
something else. The drawing claims no position, and `involo-pack check` accepts the wording.

set.description:
The position the step sets a switch, selector, lever or handle to: one of its
`positions`.

when.description:
Applies only when a decision step has answered an option with this value (decision
0022). Until it is answered, the item's target without `when` (`open: true`) applies.

TargetWhen.description: The answer a target depends on: an option and one of its values (decision 0022).

equals.description: The value that makes the target apply.

Timer.description:
A wait attached to a step: a timer chip under the step's value (on the current step before
it starts, and on its row once started, running, paused or finished), and in the
running-timers bar while it runs or is paused. Without `auto_start`, the step's own tick
starts it.

auto_start.description:
The earlier steps whose ticks start the timer; the words under the timer name them
before it starts.

label.description: The timer's name, e.g. `Warm-up`: on the chip and in the running-timers bar.

note.description: A note about the wait, for whoever writes the pack; the app doesn't show it.

seconds.description: How long the wait is, in seconds.

WalkaroundPoint.description:
Where a step's stop is on the exterior inspection's top view of the airplane (decision
0032), in the top view's units.

x.description: The stop's point across, from the top view's left edge.

y.description: The stop's point down, from the top view's top edge (the nose is up).
